description: Cheapest Working Tool: 'I need X' -> the cheapest x402 provider that ANSWERS right now. Matches from ~35,000 indexed endpoints, sorted by price, each live-probed (unpaid) in that order; returns the pick + runners-up by live price and latency, and the cheap-but-dead ones it skipped. Never pays a target. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/market/cheapest, $0.002 via x402.)
